item.text: The current screen is only a proposal form, and the logic helpers conflict with the repository’s stated domain rules: reason checks use the wrong predicate, reordering assumes the previous stored position is adjacent, and scheduling ignores notice time and appointment statuses. I’m aligning those helpers with the README contracts and extending the screen with accessible controls for the planning actions.

Implemented the delivery planning interactions in [PlanningScreen.tsx](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-JesJlH/workspace/PlanningScreen.tsx) and updated the domain logic in [logic.ts](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-JesJlH/workspace/logic.ts):

- Added stop move-up and move-down controls that submit active-stop ranks.
- Added reason fields for stops matching the domain reason rule.
- Added upload proposal prefill; changing stores resets the proposal form.
- Added schedule validation against notification time and the next eligible appointment.
